week.no_load: No computable load in this week.
week.not_computable: Activities without computable load (not in the sum): {n}

activities.empty: No activities in the chosen period.
activities.duplicate_hint: Same session as another recording, not counted in the load (duplicate rule).

detail.no_zones: No zones computable (threshold or measurement channel missing).
detail.series_file_missing: The FIT file was not found.
detail.series_file_changed: The FIT file has changed since the import. Please import again.
detail.series_unreadable: The FIT file could not be read.
detail.series_no_channels: The activity contains neither power nor heart rate.
detail.decoupling_hint: Power per heartbeat, first half against second half. Meaningful for steady sessions. Limit 5 % (rule of thumb, Q16 secondary source only).
detail.ef_hint: Normalized power divided by average heart rate, cycling from 45 minutes only (Q16, secondary source only).
detail.ef_none: Only for rides of 45 minutes or more with power and heart rate.

decoupling.no_data: Decoupling needs at least 45 minutes with power and heart rate.
decoupling.coupled: Power and heart rate kept the same ratio until the end.
decoupling.decoupled: In the second half the same power took more heartbeats.

detail.laps_statement: {n} laps from the file, averages from the recording.

garmin.note: Garmin's figures are shown for reference only. Lastwerk calculates with its own load.

settings.sync_warning: The database lives in a folder that a cloud service synchronizes. This can corrupt SQLite. The local data folder is better.
settings.statement: Lastwerk stores all FIT files itself. You do not have to choose a folder.
settings.location_hint: Next to the database in this app's data folder, separate from the program folder. Updates leave it untouched.
settings.rescan_hint: Reads all stored files once more. New and changed ones are picked up.
settings.add_files_hint: For files from an Edge device or a USB stick that do not come through Garmin Connect. Lastwerk copies them into its data folder and reads them in.
settings.add_rejected: Files without the .fit extension, unreadable files and files over 64 MiB are skipped.

import.loads: Load computed: {ok}. Not computable: {threshold} without threshold, {channel} without measurement channel, {implausible} implausible.
import.not_activity: Files without an activity (for example daily monitoring): {n}

threshold.title: Thresholds
threshold.hint: After sign-in the values come from Garmin automatically, with Garmin's date. Your own value on the same day or later takes precedence. A value applies from its date until the next one of the same kind, earlier activities keep their load.
threshold.none: No thresholds yet. Without a threshold the load is not computable.
threshold.hr_max_estimate: Maximum heart rate from age (208 minus 0.7 times age): {bpm} bpm
threshold.saved_not_applied: Saved. There are no FIT files yet; the value applies to everything you read in later.
threshold.files_skipped: Skipped because the file is missing or was changed: {n}
threshold.add_hint: For your own values that Garmin does not provide or that you set differently.

athlete.title: Athlete
athlete.hint: Sex only selects the constants of the heart rate load (TRIMP). The birth year is only used to estimate the maximum heart rate.

pmc.title: Curve: fitness, fatigue, form
pmc.hint: Time constants in days (default 42 and 7, common practice) and start values on the first day with load.

garmin.title: Connect with Garmin
garmin.lead: One login is enough: Lastwerk fetches activities, recovery and threshold values itself. No questions about FTP or heart rate.
garmin.explain: You sign in on the Garmin page in a separate window, and Lastwerk sees neither password nor code. Afterwards Lastwerk fetches new activities and recovery values to this computer, read only.
garmin.if_skipped: Without Garmin, recovery values are missing and you enter thresholds yourself in the settings. Activities still come from your own FIT files, and you can connect later in the settings.
garmin.takes: After sign-in Lastwerk takes thresholds (FTP, lactate threshold, maximum heart rate, resting heart rate), sex and birth year from Garmin. You can enter your own values later in the settings, and they then take precedence.

extras.title: While Garmin loads
extras.lead: The first sync fetches a year and takes a few minutes. Meanwhile you can decide what else Lastwerk may fetch.
extras.sync_hint: Keeps running in the background. Load and form come first, daily values follow.
extras.coach_hint: A language model on this computer explains and adjusts the plan. It computes nothing and sends nothing to the network.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.lead: Three answers and the plan starts next Monday. Everything can be changed later in the planner.
plan.waiting: Garmin is still loading your activities. Once they are here, Lastwerk suggests sport, hours and training days from your training.
plan.from_history: Suggested from your training of the last {weeks} weeks.

lead.week: What was done this week and how the load is distributed.
lead.plan: Three answers are enough for a weekly plan, the rest you work out in conversation with the coach.
lead.activities: All imported activities, duplicates are marked.
lead.detail: Metrics, zones and course of this activity.
lead.progress: Volume and load across weeks, months and years.
lead.performance: Your best values per duration and how they develop.
lead.health: Daily and training values from Garmin, each with its latest value and trend. Lastwerk does not calculate with them.
lead.settings_data: Where your data comes from: FIT files, Garmin and the local MCP server.
lead.settings_coach: A local language model on this computer. It explains and adjusts, it never calculates.
lead.settings_profile: Details about you, thresholds and the time constants of form.

about.title: About Lastwerk
about.none: There are no notes for this version.
about.repeat_hint: Walks you through Garmin, permissions, coach and plan again. Existing data stays.

update.title: Update
update.hint: Lastwerk only looks for a new version when you click, on the project's GitHub releases. There is no background check and none of your data is sent. The install verifies a signature.
update.installing: Downloading and installing, then Lastwerk restarts …
update.confirm: The app will close and restart. Your data is kept.

mcp.title: Claude as a client (MCP server)
mcp.hint: The Lastwerk MCP server is read-only and only runs when a client such as Claude Desktop starts it (see the README).
mcp.recovery: Allow recovery values for the MCP server
mcp.state_on: Allowed: get_recovery_days returns HRV, resting heart rate and sleep duration.
mcp.recovery_hint: Allowed values (HRV, resting heart rate, sleep duration) become part of the conversation with the client and go to its provider. They cannot be taken back afterwards.
mcp.confirm: Allow them? Every answer with recovery values becomes part of the conversation with the client and cannot be taken back.

goal.title: Goal
goal.label: Label
goal.label_hint: Stays local and never goes to a language model.
goal.none: No goal set. The plan runs on an ongoing basis.
goal.past: The event of the active goal is before the plan start. The plan then runs on an ongoing basis.

avail.title: Availability
avail.hint: Longest training time per weekday. Days without a setting count as {minutes} minutes with hard sessions allowed.
avail.unset: Nothing is set for {n} weekdays, the default applies there.

generate.title: Create plan
generate.weeks_hint: Empty: up to the week of the event, otherwise 8 weeks.
generate.sports_hint: No selection: the sports of the last twelve weeks, cycling without history.
generate.done: Plan created and saved as a draft.

view.empty: Select a plan or create a new one.

projection.title: Fitness, fatigue, form of the plan weeks
projection.hint: Forecast from the planned daily loads, starting the day before with fitness {ctl} and fatigue {atl}.

plan.talk_to_coach: Talk to the coach about the plan

export.title: Export and backup
export.need_plan: Select a plan first for ICS and JSON.
export.ics_hint: The ICS file contains title, time and duration, no places.
export.privacy: Backup and plan can contain personal details, for example the label of the goal. The files do not belong in a public repository.
export.restore_confirm: Restoring replaces all user data (thresholds, goals, availability, plans, settings) with the content of the chosen file. Activities and figures stay unchanged.
export.restored_hint: Then read the files again in the settings under Data or run `lastwerk rebuild --dir <folder>` on the command line so that activities and figures match the thresholds again.
export.counts: {thresholds} thresholds, {goals} goals, {availability} availability entries, {plans} plans, {settings} settings, {recovery_days} recovery days

today.starts_hint: Until then, train freely or rest. The planner already shows the first week.

form.label: Form state
form.fresh_hint: You are rested. Hard sessions pay off.
form.balanced_hint: Load and recovery are in balance.
form.loaded_hint: You are carrying fatigue. That is normal in a build.
form.overloaded_hint: Fatigue is high. Stay easy and recover.
form.rule_note: Limits are a rule of thumb, the limit at -30 matches R10.

ramp.no_data: The ramp needs one more week of history.
ramp.falling: Your fitness is falling by {value} points per week.
ramp.steady: Your fitness is staying about the same.
ramp.building: Your fitness is rising by {value} points per week, within the plan limit of {limit}.
ramp.steep: Your fitness is rising by {value} points per week, faster than the plan limit of {limit}.

distribution.no_data: There is not enough time in zones yet for a statement, at least one hour in 28 days.

distribution.intensity_heavy: Only {share} % of your time in zones is in zone 1 and 2, the plan asks for at least {min} %.

adherence.no_data: No load was planned for this week up to yesterday.

adherence.on_track: You have done {ratio} % of the load planned up to yesterday, in line with the plan.
adherence.over: You have done {ratio} % of the load planned up to yesterday, more than planned.

efficiency.no_data: The trend needs longer rides with power and heart rate.
efficiency.falling: Your power per heartbeat has fallen by {change} % compared with the 28 days before.
efficiency.flat: Your power per heartbeat is unchanged compared with the 28 days before.
efficiency.rising: Your power per heartbeat has risen by {change} % compared with the 28 days before.

power_curve.no_data: The comparison needs power data from both periods.
power_curve.falling: Your best efforts are below those of the 90 days before. That can be due to missing maximal efforts.
power_curve.flat: Your best efforts are about the same as in the 90 days before.
power_curve.rising: Your best efforts of the last 90 days are above those of the 90 days before.

readiness.no_data: The recovery values are not enough yet for a comparison with your average.
readiness.normal: HRV and sleep duration are within your average of the last seven days.
readiness.low: Your recovery values are clearly below your average of the last seven days.

form.title: Form history
form.empty: No load computed yet. Connect Garmin or import FIT files, then your history appears here.
form.projection_note: The projection uses the planned load of the active plan.
form.week_ahead: In seven days according to the plan: {tsb}
form.loading: Garmin is loading your activities. Once they are here, your fitness, fatigue and form history appears.

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.empty: Connect Garmin for recovery values, then HRV, resting heart rate and sleep appear here against your own average.
readiness.stale: The latest recovery value is from {date}, too old for a statement about today.
readiness.short_baseline: Comparing with your average needs more days with recovery values.
readiness.plan_adjusted: Lastwerk adjusted: the first hard session of the plan was replaced by an easy one.
readiness.loading: Garmin is loading your recovery values. Then HRV, resting heart rate and sleep appear here compared with your own average.

ramp.label: Fitness per week
ramp.chart_label: Ramp of the last twelve weeks

distribution.week_empty: Week from {date}: no time in zones

adherence.no_plan: Without an active plan there is nothing to compare.

calendar.title: Load calendar
calendar.statement: {days} training days with {total} load in total over the last twelve months.
calendar.empty: No computed load in the calendar yet. Import activities and set thresholds.
calendar.hint: Hover a cell for the value of the day.
calendar.chart_label: Daily load of the last 365 days as a calendar

garmin.title: Garmin
garmin.statement: Activities, recovery, daily and training values and thresholds straight from Garmin, without a companion program.
garmin.risk: Unofficial access: Garmin offers no open interface to private users. Lastwerk uses the path of the Garmin app, and Garmin can change or block it at any time.
garmin.waiting: The Garmin sign-in window is open. You enter password and code only there.
garmin.sync_on_start_hint: Once after opening, only when connected. No schedule, nothing in the background.
garmin.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect? Lastwerk deletes the sign-in data from the keychain. To revoke access completely, also do so in your Garmin account settings.
garmin.disconnected: Disconnected. To revoke access completely, also do so in your Garmin account settings.
garmin.locked_until: Requests paused until {time} because Garmin throttled several times.
garmin.bridge_hint: Only for the frozen companion program: what is in the exchange folder?
garmin.bridge_has_data: The companion program delivers data: {days} days of recovery, {files} FIT files.
garmin.bridge_no_data: No data in the exchange folder.

code.cancelled: Sign-in cancelled. The window was closed.
code.unexpected_redirect: After sign-in, Garmin redirected differently than expected. Please try again later.

garmin.never_fetched: Lastwerk never fetches menstrual or pregnancy data.

s3.title: Sensitive values (S3)
s3.hint: Sensitive health data, allowed per area. Lastwerk fetches it only when allowed, stores it separately and never gives it to the MCP server. Off by default.
s3.delete_confirm: Delete all stored values for {name}? This cannot be undone. If the permission stays on, the next sync fetches values again.

planner.title: Your plan in three questions
planner.hours_hint: The ceiling for the whole week. The planner spreads it evenly over your training days.
planner.q_days: On which days can you train?
planner.done: The plan is created and active.
planner.fine_hint: Goal with a name, time per day, sports, plan list, export and backup.

coach.statement: Say what you would like to change. The coach suggests, only what you confirm is applied.
coach.checking: Checking whether a model is running …

suggestion.busy_day: I have no time on Tuesday
suggestion.more_running: I would like to run more
suggestion.low_form: Why is my form so low?

setup.title: The coach needs a local model
setup.lead: It runs entirely on your computer, nothing goes online. The planner works without it.

reason.no_model: Ollama is running at {url} but has no model yet.
reason.bad_url: The address {url} is not allowed. The coach only talks to your own computer.
reason.not_configured: The model server is not set up yet.

setup.open_settings: Go to the setup in the settings

preview.title: This goes to the model
preview.target: {provider} at {url}, model {model}. Nothing leaves your computer.
preview.note: Exactly this text goes to the model: instructions, plan and rounded figures, plus your conversation. No names, paths or files.

proposal.warnings: The new plan carries {n} rule warnings.
proposal.applied: Applied. The new plan is now active.
proposal.rejected: The proposal did not pass the rules and was discarded: {codes}.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.text: Your messages and your plan with rounded figures go to the model {model} on this computer. Nothing leaves it, and nothing changes until you apply a proposal. You can see exactly what is sent at any time under “What does the coach see?”.

drawer.shortcut: Open or close the coach (Ctrl+J, Cmd+J on Mac)

migration.title: Earlier FIT folder taken over
migration.done: Lastwerk copied the files from your previous FIT folder into its own data folder: {copied} new, {identical} were already there. Nothing in the old folder was changed.
migration.conflicts: Left unchanged because a different file already existed at the same path: {n}.
migration.failed: Not copied: {n}. Lastwerk tries again on the next start.
migration.missing: Your previous FIT folder was not found, perhaps the drive is not connected. Its files stay there. Under Settings, Data you can add them with "Add FIT files".

coach_setup.title: Local coach
coach_setup.statement: The coach runs with Ollama entirely on your computer. Only downloading Ollama and the models goes over the network, and only after you click.

state.installed: Ollama is installed but not running

coach_setup.hardware: Your computer: {ram} GB memory, no NVIDIA graphics card found
coach_setup.hardware_gpu: Your computer: {ram} GB memory, {vram} GB graphics memory
coach_setup.install_hint: Lastwerk installs Ollama through winget or from ollama.com, checks the signature and starts it. Downloading takes a few minutes depending on your connection. Then you pick a model.
coach_setup.declined: You declined the setup in the installer. You can do it here at any time.

manual.title: Install Ollama by hand
manual.step_install: Download Ollama from ollama.com and install it.
manual.step_pick: Then pick a model here and load it.

model.qwen3_4b: Starter model: a good mix of speed and quality

coach_setup.background: You can carry on, the download keeps running in the background.
coach_setup.pulled: {name} is loaded and used by the coach.
coach_setup.fits_all: All sizes are rules of thumb and were not measured.

lead.empty: No activities yet. As soon as Lastwerk has data, the comparison with last year appears here.

lead.compare: {value} this year, {change} compared with last year up to the same day.

weeks.hint: Point at a bar for the week's values.

power.title: Power curve
power.empty: No rides with power in this period.

run.empty: No runs with speed data in this period.

thr.empty: No thresholds yet and no ride with 20 minutes of power. Set them in the settings.
thr.others: No FTP set; the other thresholds are listed below.

thr.above: The suggestion from {month} at {value} is above your FTP of {ftp}.

thr.note: Suggestion: 95 % of the month's best 20-minute power (rule of thumb, Q16 secondary source only). It holds only if the 20 minutes were ridden all out, and is never applied by itself.

lead.plan: {month}: {done} of {planned} planned sessions done up to yesterday, {missed} days missed.
lead.sessions: {month}: {n} sessions, the plan starts later or lies ahead.
lead.no_plan: {month}: {n} sessions. Without an active plan the calendar only shows what you did.

lead.normal: The latest day is within your own range. Days below the lower bound in the last {days} days: {n}.

rec.none: There are no recovery values in this period.
rec.to_settings: Go to Garmin in the settings
rec.hint: Point at a chart for the values of a day.
rec.base: own baseline (avg of the 7 days before)
rec.hrv_statement: Overnight HRV against the mean of the seven days before; from {pct} % below, the planner adjusts the next hard session.

rec.sleep_statement: Sleep duration against the mean of the seven days before; from {pct} % below, the same rule applies.

rec.load_statement: Daily load on the same time axis, so you see recovery and training side by side.

health.none: No values yet. They arrive with the Garmin sync, which you can connect under Settings, Garmin.
health.daily_statement: Values per day from Garmin. Days without a value stay gaps.
health.training_statement: Garmin's own estimates. Lastwerk only shows them and calculates with its own load.
health.note: These values describe training data, not health in a medical sense.
health.status_statement: Garmin's training status with acute and chronic load and the load focus of the last four weeks. For viewing only, Lastwerk computes its own load.
health.race_statement: Garmin's estimate of race times from VO2max and training.
health.tolerance_statement: Running distance of the last 7 days compared with what Garmin considers tolerable.
health.s3_statement: Sensitive values, fetched only after you allow them in Settings and stored separately.

hint.no_plan: Three questions in the planner are enough, then this shows what is up today and why.

hint.lighten_empty: No easy template of this sport in the catalog fits the planned duration. Talk to the coach about what to do instead.

reason.form_overloaded: Your form is overloaded: fatigue is far above fitness.
reason.form_fresh: Your form is fresh and your recovery values are within range, so today you could do more.
reason.recovery_swap: The planner already replaced the hard session with an easy one because of your recovery values.

missing.form: Without computed load there is no form state yet.
missing.plan_context: The plan could not be checked, so there is no harder option.

decision.alt_hint: Alternatives do not change the plan. You can adopt one through the coach.

ask.rest: Why is today a rest day?
ask.already_adjusted: Why was my hard session replaced with an easy one today?
ask.lighten: Why should I train easier than planned today?
ask.keep_easy: Why should I keep it easy today?
ask.as_planned: Does the planned session fit me today?

form.overloaded: My form is overloaded. How should I plan the next days?

ramp.steep: My fitness is rising faster than the plan's limit. Should I change something?

R01.name: Fitness ramp
R01.explanation: Fitness (CTL) should rise only by a limited amount per week. Source: rule of thumb.

R02.name: Weekly volume increase
R02.explanation: Training time rises only by a limited amount over the previous week. Warning from 10 percent, rejection from 30 percent. Source: rule of thumb, no reliable protective effect shown (Q12, Q13).

R03.name: Hard sessions per week
R03.explanation: At most two hard sessions per week. Source: rule of thumb, descriptive Q5.

R04.name: No hard sessions on consecutive days
R04.explanation: At least one day without a hard session lies between two hard sessions. Source: rule of thumb.

R05.name: Rest day
R05.explanation: At least one day per week without a session. Source: rule of thumb.

R06.name: Recovery week
R06.explanation: After three load weeks comes a week with 60 to 70 percent of the load. Source: rule of thumb, not proven.

R07.name: Strength training
R07.explanation: One to two strength sessions per week, not on the day before a hard session, at most one in the taper. Source: rule of thumb.

R08.name: Share of easy training
R08.explanation: At least 70 percent of the time in zones 1 and 2. Source: Q5 (descriptive, about 80 percent), limit is a rule of thumb.

R09.name: Taper before the race
R09.explanation: Seven to fourteen days, volume drops, intensity stays. Source: Q10 (principle), duration is a rule of thumb.

R10.name: Form not too low
R10.explanation: The projected form (TSB) should not fall below -30. Source: rule of thumb.

R11.name: Availability
R11.explanation: Training time per weekday never exceeds your input, fixed rest days and days without hard sessions are kept. Source: user input.

R12.name: Recovery data
R12.explanation: If HRV or sleep duration of the latest day are clearly below the average of the days before, the next hard session is replaced by an easy one. Source: Q6 (HRV monitoring, the 7-day average only from a secondary report), thresholds are rules of thumb. Without recovery data nothing changes.
